fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Link button text (optional)
fields.description: Fill in to show a clear clickable button after the message, e.g. "Shop the vinyl". Leave blank to show just the message (if a Link is set, the whole banner stays clickable).

fields.name: album
fields.label: Album
fields.description: Lyrics only — the album/release this song is from.

fields.name: song
fields.label: Song title
fields.description: Lyrics only — use if the song title differs from the title above.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date (optional)
fields.description: Used only to order pieces; leave blank to sort by title.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Enter starts a new stanza. Shift+Enter starts a new line inside the same stanza — use it for the lines of a verse.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
